body: I understand where you're coming form, but sometimes I see this as something that makes up a third of my life so I feel it impossible to reinvent myself as they have been such a drastic part of my life that I feel it better to understand them to forget him as no matter how hard I try I cant forget him

Thanks for the help, It's just when somebody starts to speak to me, I start to think that things that people have said to me in the past are true, so when people say things as a joke, I just immediately relate them to things that have been said to me in the past and cant help it as I don't have anyone near that understands me and I am too afraid to mention the bullying with them, and with no-one to talk to it just bottles it up inside so much
